description: Physical access controls are not implemented to enforce physical access authorizations and verify individual access at entry and exit points.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing physical access control systems, lack of badge readers or biometric controls, absence of guards or monitoring at entry/exit points, inadequate verification of authorization credentials, and missing controls for controlling ingress/egress.
